[[Al Ahly SC|Al Ahly]] were crowned champions for the third year in a row and for the thirty-second time in total since the league start in 1948.{{Cite web |title=Summary - Premier League - Egypt - Results, fixtures, tables and news - Soccerway |url=https://us.soccerway.com/national/egypt/premier-league/2006-2007/regular-season/r3762/ |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231123133251/https://us.soccerway.com/national/egypt/premier-league/2006-2007/regular-season/r3762/ |archive-date=2023-11-23 |access-date=2025-05-26 |website=us.soccerway.com |language=en}} == Clubs == {{For|a full list of clubs|List of football clubs in Egypt}} * [[Al Ahly SC|Al Ahly]] * [[Aluminium Nag Hammâdi|Al-Aluminium]] * [[Asmant Suez]] * [[Baladeyet Al-Mahalla]] * [[ENPPI SC|ENPPI]] * [[Ghazl Al-Mehalla|Ghazl Al Mehalla]] * [[Tala'ea El Gaish SC|Tala'ea El Gaish]] * [[Sawahel|Haras El Hodood]] * [[Al-Ismaili|Al Ismaili]] * [[Al-Itthad Al-Iskandary|Al Itthad Al Sakandary]] * [[Al-Masry|Al Masry]] * [[Mokawloon al-Arab|Al Mokawloon]] * [[Itesalat]] * [[Petrojet SC|Petrojet]] * [[Tersana]] * [[Al-Zamalek|Al Zamalek]] == Stadiums == [[Borg El Arab Stadium]] in Alexandria opened recently and it will be the home of majority of the Alexandria clubs. The stadium has a capacity of 80,000. In 2007, [[Damanhour Stadium]] in the city of Damanhour will go into construction. Its capacity will be 60,000. In 2009, [[Mubarak International Stadium]] will go into construction in Six October City & its capacity will be 65,000. In 2009 the [[Cairo Military Academy Stadium]] will be rebuilt and its capacity will be 65,000. As well Ismailia has future plans for expansion or a new venue with a capacity of a minimum of 45,000. {| class="wikitable sortable" |- ! Stadium ! City !
